keyPoints.en: Metabolism is the total of all chemical reactions in an organism, controlled by enzymes.
keyPoints.bm: Metabolisme ialah jumlah semua tindak balas kimia dalam organisma, dikawal oleh enzim.

keyPoints.en: Anabolism: building larger molecules from smaller ones, needs energy (photosynthesis, protein synthesis, glycogen formation).
keyPoints.bm: Anabolisme: membina molekul besar daripada molekul kecil, memerlukan tenaga (fotosintesis, sintesis protein, pembentukan glikogen).

keyPoints.en: Catabolism: breaking larger molecules into smaller ones, releases energy (respiration, digestion).
keyPoints.bm: Katabolisme: memecahkan molekul besar kepada kecil, membebaskan tenaga (respirasi, pencernaan).

keyPoints.en: Metabolic rate depends on age, gender, activity, body size and hormones (e.g. thyroxine).
keyPoints.bm: Kadar metabolisme bergantung pada umur, jantina, aktiviti, saiz badan dan hormon (cth. tiroksina).

question.en: Is the formation of glycogen in the liver anabolism or catabolism?
question.bm: Adakah pembentukan glikogen dalam hati anabolisme atau katabolisme?

answer.en: Anabolism — many glucose molecules join to form glycogen.
answer.bm: Anabolisme — banyak molekul glukosa bergabung membentuk glikogen.

keyPoints.en: Enzymes are proteins that act as biological catalysts: they speed up reactions without being used up.
keyPoints.bm: Enzim ialah protein yang bertindak sebagai mangkin biologi: mempercepat tindak balas tanpa habis digunakan.

keyPoints.en: Each enzyme is specific to one substrate — lock-and-key hypothesis via the active site.
keyPoints.bm: Setiap enzim spesifik kepada satu substrat — hipotesis mangga dan kunci melalui tapak aktif.

keyPoints.en: Temperature: activity rises to an optimum (~37 °C) then falls as the enzyme denatures.
keyPoints.bm: Suhu: aktiviti meningkat hingga optimum (~37 °C) kemudian menurun apabila enzim ternyahasli.

keyPoints.en: pH: each enzyme has an optimum pH (pepsin 2, amylase 7, trypsin 8); extreme pH denatures.
keyPoints.bm: pH: setiap enzim mempunyai pH optimum (pepsin 2, amilase 7, tripsin 8); pH melampau menyahaslikan.

keyPoints.en: Higher substrate or enzyme concentration increases rate until another factor becomes limiting.
keyPoints.bm: Kepekatan substrat atau enzim yang lebih tinggi meningkatkan kadar sehingga faktor lain menjadi penghad.

question.en: Why does chewing rice for a long time make it taste sweet?
question.bm: Mengapa mengunyah nasi lama-lama menjadikannya terasa manis?

answer.en: Salivary amylase hydrolyses starch into maltose, a sugar.
answer.bm: Amilase liur menghidrolisis kanji kepada maltosa, sejenis gula.

tip.en: Low temperature = inactive (reversible). High temperature = denatured (permanent).
tip.bm: Suhu rendah = tidak aktif (boleh berbalik). Suhu tinggi = ternyahasli (kekal).

keyPoints.en: Food: papain and bromelain tenderise meat; pectinase clears juices; rennin makes cheese; lactase makes lactose-free milk; amylase in baking.
keyPoints.bm: Makanan: papain dan bromelain melembutkan daging; pektinase menjernihkan jus; renin membuat keju; laktase membuat susu tanpa laktosa; amilase dalam pembakaran.

keyPoints.en: Household: biological detergents contain protease and lipase to remove stains at low temperatures.
keyPoints.bm: Rumah: detergen biologi mengandungi protease dan lipase untuk menanggalkan kotoran pada suhu rendah.

keyPoints.en: Industry: trypsin softens leather; cellulase in textile and paper processing.
keyPoints.bm: Industri: tripsin melembutkan kulit; selulase dalam pemprosesan tekstil dan kertas.

keyPoints.en: Medicine: glucose oxidase in diabetic test strips; enzymes in diagnostic kits.
keyPoints.bm: Perubatan: glukosa oksidase dalam jalur ujian diabetes; enzim dalam kit diagnostik.

keyPoints.en: Advantages: specific, work at low temperature (save energy), reusable, biodegradable.
keyPoints.bm: Kelebihan: spesifik, berfungsi pada suhu rendah (jimat tenaga), boleh diguna semula, terbiodegradasi.

question.en: Why does raw pineapple stop jelly from setting?
question.bm: Mengapa nanas mentah menghalang agar-agar daripada membeku?

answer.en: Bromelain (a protease) digests the gelatin protein. Canned pineapple is heated, so the enzyme is denatured.
answer.bm: Bromelain (protease) mencerna protein gelatin. Nanas dalam tin telah dipanaskan, jadi enzim ternyahasli.

tip.en: For each use, name the enzyme, its substrate and the benefit.
tip.bm: Bagi setiap kegunaan, namakan enzim, substratnya dan manfaatnya.
